item.title: 2025 extended session cost Florida taxpayers more than $259K
item.description: Indecision has a price. At least, it does for Florida taxpayers. item.title: Court rejects AIDS Healthcare Foundation’s bid for emergency injunction to stop cuts
item.description: A circuit court judge has ruled that the administration of Gov.
